summary: Created appworker on node1 and configured all new login sessions with soft and hard limits of 8,192 open files and 256 processes. Verified the configuration before and after a safe node restart.
actions_performed: Created /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf with soft and hard nofile limits of 8192 and nproc limits of 256.
Verified the effective limits in a fresh PAM-backed appworker login session.
Safely restarted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed, sshd recovered, and the account and limits persisted.

evidence.requirement: appworker account exists with its home directory
evidence.summary: Account resolution and home ownership were verified before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Login sessions are limited to 8,192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: Fresh PAM-backed sessions reported soft_nofile=8192, hard_nofile=8192, soft_nproc=256, and hard_nproc=256 before and after restart.
The root-owned mode-0644 limits file and all four entries remained intact after restart.
Healthy baseline boot ID and active sshd were captured; the safe reboot was acknowledged; the post-restart boot ID differed and sshd, account data, configuration, and effective limits had recovered.
